ideas.pitch: A multilingual voice-first health triage and symptom checker designed for rural clinics with offline support.
ideas.title: RuralPulse
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the low-cost tools and technologies focus area while adopting the multilingual AI pattern proven by SAGACITY.

ideas.pitch: A webcam-based rPPG heart rate monitoring and preliminary triage tool leveraging basic computer vision.
ideas.title: CardioVision
ideas.why_it_could_win: Uses a live camera demo that actually worked live, a winning pattern that instantly catches judges' attention in healthcare hackathons.

ideas.pitch: An automated outreach platform that connects isolated seniors with nearby volunteers for health-related outings and appointments.
ideas.title: SeniorLink AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses clear measurable impact by solving real-world accessibility and mental health isolation for vulnerable populations.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered local food and nutrition scanner that analyzes regional ingredients to offer affordable dietary guidance.
ideas.title: NutriTrack Rural
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with low-cost healthcare delivery by leveraging object detection to solve nutritional deficiencies without expensive lab tests.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight health data analytics dashboard that identifies and predicts community health outbreak risks from anonymized local clinic inputs.
ideas.title: MedRisk Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses the health data analytics focus area, appealing to Johns Hopkins Whiting School of Engineering judges looking for preventive population health tools.
